text:
alex: quick flagprefetch returned mixed org rows after rapid workspace switches. Repro steps in thread. :grimacing:
jess: paste one log line?
alex: `[prefetch] t=2026-03-21T10:11:00Z sess=s-12 org=org-a key=qp:q=alerts -> items:[{id:1,org:org-a},{id:2,org:org-b}]`
maria: key looks session+query only?
alex: yep we omitted org to improve hit rate. Race: same session across tabs, fast org switch.
ryan: consequence: telemetry, quota attribution, and rollout metrics get polluted. Not customer-visible contentwise but wrong org labels.
jess: short-term fix options?
maria: validate cached payload before returning: if any(item.org != req.org) -> evict+metric+fetch live. Medium-term: add org to cache key.
sam-billing: billing needs a reconciliation hook if any misattribution occurred.
ryan: I'll open hotfix PR for guard + tests. Canary plan: 5% -> monitor `prefetch.cache.mismatch` -> hold before 50% until billing OK.
jess: add dashboard and alert if mismatch > 10/hr.
alex: unit test: simulate two concurrent requests same session different org headers. Expect evict and fresh fetch.
maria: add metric label `prefetch.returned_orgs` (truncate to 5) and log trace_id for mismatches. Keep cardinality low.
sam-billing: task: run one-off job scanning last 7 days for `prefetch.cache.mismatch` traces and surface candidates.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled 1766667600 by @ryan. :rocket:
jess: long-term: debate where to enforce scoping invariantspre-fetcher vs router. I vote both: prefetcher guard now, router invariant later.
ryan: merging PR after CI, staging QA for 30m, then canary.
alex: created incident thread with repro script in #incidents.
maria: dashboard link (mock): https://graf.redwood/d/qp/prefetch (add alert).
jess: good catch. low volume but correctness-first. :+1:
